Error: Instance cannot be destroyed

  on secrets.tf line 1:
   1: resource "google_secret_manager_secret" "this" {

Resource module.repo.google_secret_manager_secret.this["claude-oauth-token-bmb"] has
lifecycle.prevent_destroy set, but the plan calls for this resource to be
destroyed. To avoid this error and continue with the plan, either disable
lifecycle.prevent_destroy or reduce the scope of the plan using the -target
option.
